complete_grouped_result: limit:null; used for fresh grouped aggregates with no requested top-N/limit. Invented model limits are reconciled and reported before full semantic/request validation.

resource_bound.overflow_policy: Clear error, no primary table, evidence, chart or savable partial answer. Bound is not raised.

explicit_limits: Requested integer N remains exact, within existing 1–100 guard.
followups: Referenced prior selections retain their limit and group membership, including prior complete results with null limits.
other_operations: Null limit rejected; existing integer bounds retained.
saved_analyses: New null limits and existing integer limits replay through the same canonical plan format; no migration or data rewrite.
publication: Local commit only; no push, merge, rebuild, model change or deployment.
